"Marcus is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."

"I sit apart to eat. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
"Alright — I should get back to it."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."

"Can I tell you something? At night I cry quietly so no one hears."
"Walk with me? I want another pair of eyes on something."

"...Thanks. ...That's enough, for now. What could go wrong."
"That's... pretty much all of it, honestly."
"Yeah? What's up? Funny how that works."
"I dreamed Marcus was still here. Woke up angry at the dream. Stupid."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:

"Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."

lines: d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Marcus Sanders is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Marcus Sanders is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d42: What Marcus kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d42: "Marcus's gone." Dakota looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Marcus." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d42: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Wanda blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Swimmer (Level 1). Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.

d42: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Marcus's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
d42: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Marcus Sanders, 42 days. The mantle passes to Wanda Wozniak.
d42: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Wanda Wozniak, 30 — a Fisherman. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location.
d42: The village's quarrel was with Marcus — and Marcus is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d42: At the grave, Dakota, Chaymae, Chantal and 2 more speak for Wanda — "Marcus trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d42: The fire knew Wanda before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d71: 🏆 The Company did that. Not one hero — the whole shape of them, moving together. The village will hear this one with the name attached.
